given.note: A6-32: Sam OK'd Alex's request for a Color correction, and the $25 deposit charged on his saved card was declined. The decline is never retried; Alex gets one link to pay what is due, by the request's latest answer time (clock.pay, 17:00Z here, held by the clock row). This makes the payment Rosie's own pay page takes, rosfield.com/p/f4; paid in time, it is booked and that card is the one saved for it.
